designationHistory.indexText: Buck Island National Wildlife Refuge, off St. Thomas, was established when the U.S. Navy transferred most of the island to the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service.

authority.citation: Transfer of land from the U.S. Navy

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Buck Island National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

USFWS, 508 Sandy Point, Green Cay, and Buck Island National Wildlife Refuges Comprehensive Conservation Plan (ServCat 169407): "Buck Island NWR, St. Thomas, was established in 1969"; about 35 acres obtained from the U.S. Navy in 1969

review.note: Draft sentence described Laguna Cartagena NWR (Puerto Rico, 1989). Buck Island NWR (St. Thomas) dates to 1969 (CCP).

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Laguna Cartagena National Wildlife Refuge Established in 1989, Laguna Cartagena National Wildlife Refuge is one of the most important freshwater habitats for migrating and resident aquatic birds in Puerto Rico.
